title: RAW UNREVIEWED: fochor as a shared Viola name across independently identified plants
summary: If another already admitted Herbal image is independently identified as the same Viola taxon or an explicitly related Viola taxon, freeze both identifications without reading their prose. A name reading predicts a recoverable repeated whole or predeclared related form in its own name slot; a generic Herbal opener predicts only positional reuse without taxon selectivity. The relation and usable second owner are unverified, and f9v alone cannot decide it.

design.mechanism: A taxon name is conserved or changes by a declared taxonomic name rule across independently owned same-taxon entries.
design.unit: Complete first prose units of f9v and each eligible already admitted, independently identified Viola page, with matched non-Viola Herbal controls.
design.contrast: taxon-selective lexical relation versus general entry-head distribution
design.prediction: The candidate name relation is enriched among independently keyed Viola owners and absent or predictably different among matched controls; if no second owner or no relation exists, return missing binding or failed name hypothesis.
design.scope: Raw idea only; no new image admission, manuscript source access, or target inspection.
